title: Every task on the DR1 hub is a link a user can follow in any order; the frontend locks a row shut behind the answers that come before it and shows 'Cannot start yet'.

finding.frontend: A frontend hub row is a link only if the first page behind it passes its entry gate; when it does not, the row is rendered as plain text with the status 'Cannot start yet' and no way in (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/hub/controller.js:93-123). Those gates chain on two answers — country of origin and the commodity selection (src/server/app/bridge/obligation-source.js:30-33) — and every page that sits after them in the journey order demands them (src/server/app/flow/prerequisites.js:13-27). A user who has given their country of origin but not yet chosen a commodity comes back to the hub and finds 'Main reason for importing' and every unconditional row below it reading 'Cannot start yet' — nine of the eleven rows on the page, from the reason for import through to check and submit, are plain black text with no way in. That hub is fe-hub-no-commodity: the only two rows a user can open are the one they have already answered and the commodity picker itself. A conditional row whose questions are all out of scope is dropped from the list entirely rather than blocked (:116-118), which is why 'Exit details' is absent from that page rather than shut.
finding.prototype: DR1's hub gives every task an href with no condition attached (app/routes.js:5734-5836) and the template renders each one as a link (app/views/notification-hub.html:60-75). There is no blocked presentation and no 'Cannot start yet' wording anywhere in DR1. A user can open the tasks in whatever order suits them and leave gaps behind.
finding.difference: Stop deciding whether a hub row is a link from the answers given elsewhere in the notification. Each row should link to its own first page whatever else is unanswered, which means the prerequisite chain that makes country of origin and the commodity selection preconditions for every later page has to stop applying to hub entry. Where a page genuinely cannot be filled in without an earlier answer — an identification page that needs to know which commodity, say — that has to be handled on the page itself rather than by hiding the way in. The 'Cannot start yet' status goes with the blocked presentation.
finding.falsifiedBy: A frontend hub reached on a notification where the commodity has not been chosen that still renders 'Arrival details' and the rows below it as links.
finding.correction: Verified against both pictures, both rendered DOMs and both sides' source at the pinned commits (frontend 76a864ba, prototype 491b3926). The finding survives; two things in it were overstated and have been narrowed. First, it claimed that with no commodity chosen 'everything from Main reason for importing downwards' reads 'Cannot start yet'. Conditional rows do not behave that way: src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/hub/controller.js:116-118 drops a conditional row from the list when its status is NA, so 'Exit details' and 'Transit countries' vanish rather than block. Rewritten to say so. Second, it implied the captured hub's one blocked row demonstrates the prerequisite chain. It does not: the review row is blocked by the review section's own gate on readyForCheckYourAnswers (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/flow/flow.js:81-85) via buildReviewItem (controller.js:72-91), which is different machinery from pagePrerequisites. Rewritten to say so. Every citation resolves as written: obligation-source.js:30-33 is exactly the ENFORCED_AT_CONTINUE set of countryOfOrigin and commoditySelection; prerequisites.js:13-27 is the flow-order prerequisite walk; app/routes.js:5734-5836 is the whole DR1 hub view model, in which every one of the ten items carries an unconditional href; app/views/notification-hub.html:60-75 is the loop that renders each as an anchor. 'Cannot start yet' appears nowhere in DR1. Confidence stays high: the blocked presentation and DR1's uniform linking are both visible in the two shots. SECOND PASS, after the state was captured: fe-hub-no-commodity is precisely the state this finding's falsifier asks for — a frontend hub on a notification where the commodity has not been chosen — and it was shot after the finding was written. It confirms rather than falsifies. Nine of the eleven rows carry no anchor and read 'Cannot start yet'; only 'Where is this consignment coming from?' and 'What are you importing?' are links. The narrowing the first pass made from source is visible in the same picture: 'Exit details' is not on the page at all rather than blocked, which is the conditional-row drop at controller.js:116-118 doing what the correction said it does. Confidence was already high and does not move; what changes is that the frontend slot now describes the picture instead of pointing at a hub that did not show the prerequisite chain.

relatedTo.why: the exit-details row is a defective instance of the same gating machinery, and fixing the gating removes it
'Cannot start yet' is one of the five frontend statuses DR1 does not have
